title: Compute bond‑orbital model results, dielectric constants, and dynamic effective charges
action: Implement the bond‑orbital model for the Si–O–Si bonding unit using the provided parameters (structural: d, φ; model: S, W2, W3 for SiO₂ and GeO₂; extrapolation rules for GeO₂). Evaluate the polarities β_px, β_pz, the covalent energy E₂(z), the electrostatic term, and the Madelung constant A_M(θ). Construct the total energy per bonding unit E_tot(θ,z) and minimize with respect to effective charge z at each angle θ to obtain Z0*(θ). For SiO₂, compute Z0* and the total energy landscape vs θ (0°–50°) first without Si–Si repulsion and then including the short‑range repulsion U(R)=U₀(R₀/R)¹² (U₀=1.68 eV, R₀=3.06 Å), and record the angle minimum in each case. For GeO₂, compute Z0* and the derivative ∂Z*/∂θ for SiO₂ evaluated at the equilibrium angle. Additionally, compute the electronic dielectric constant ε∞ for α‑quartz (d=1.61 Å, φ=144°, N=0.3187 Å⁻³), β‑cristobalite (d=1.55 Å, φ=144°, N=0.2615 Å⁻³), vitreous silica (d=1.61 Å, φ=144°, N=0.2573 Å⁻³), and GeO₂ quartzlike (d=1.74 Å, φ=130°, N=0.2977 Å⁻³) using Eq. (47) with γ'=1 (and factor 1.18 for GeO₂). Also compute the dynamic effective charges eₓ*, e_y*, e_z* and the ratio (R/Px)(∂Px/∂R) for SiO₂ and GeO₂ using formulas from Sec. IXB with γ=1. Write all results to the specified JSON file.
description: Single JSON containing all key quantities: static charges, angle minima, dielectric constants, and dynamic effective charges.
output_schema: {"Z0_SiO2": number, "Z0_GeO2": number, "angle_min_covalent_only": number (degrees), "angle_min_with_repulsion": number (degrees), "dZ_dtheta_SiO2": number (per radian), "alpha_quartz": number, "beta_cristobalite": number, "vitreous_silica": number, "GeO2_quartzlike": number, "e_x_SiO2": number, "e_y_SiO2": number, "e_z_SiO2": number, "RoverPx_deriv_SiO2": number, "e_x_GeO2": number, "e_y_GeO2": number, "e_z_GeO2": number, "RoverPx_deriv_GeO2": number}
